hook.text_top: Alien and zombie fight for the last donut.
hook.voice: An alien and a zombie freeze time to battle for the last donut.

intro_voice: Here's the original, made with Seedance 2.5.

shots.excerpt: Medium shot pushing along the counter. Spilled coffee hangs frozen mid-air as a zombie and an alien stare down over the last donut.
shots.voice: Shot one. A slow push past frozen coffee establishes the deadpan standoff.

shots.excerpt: Wide tracking shot down diner floor. The zombie lunges with a stiff swipe; the alien ducks, kicks a stool, and scrambles away.
shots.voice: Shot two. The brawl kicks off with a low tracking slide down the aisle.

shots.excerpt: Medium shot angled along counter stools. The alien vaults onto the counter and fires a bright camera flash into the zombie's face.
shots.voice: Shot three. The alien hops onto the counter and blinds him with a camera flash.

shots.excerpt: Wide tracking shot facing the red neon sign. The alien leaps mid-air across booth backs, evading the zombie's grasping hands.
shots.voice: Shot four. A wide stunt angle captures the alien leaping across the diner booths.

shots.excerpt: Medium shot at display case. Time snaps back, coffee splashes down, and both dive cheek-to-cheek onto the lone donut.
shots.voice: Shot five. Time unfreezes as liquid splashes and both creatures mash together over the pastry.

outro_voice: The full prompt is in the caption. Follow Mira AI for a new one every day.
